about: Per-frame phone screen track for the scroll video, written by tools/track_screen.py. corners: TL, TR, BR, BL of the screen (notch at the top) in video UV, origin top-left. tile: [atlas tile, channel 0=R 1=G 2=B] of screen_matte (the screen-visible matte rectified to the UI rect, 1 = screen shows, 0 = finger).
